cohort: 25,344 women who had a vaginal delivery or cesarean section in 14 Regional Women's Hospitals of Ukraine
finding: The overall infection rate of postpartum endometritis was 9.7%, with rates of 7.6% after vaginal delivery and 16.4% after cesarean section.
mod_finding: Incidence of postpartum endometritis after cesarean section is affected mainly by the mode of delivery, with rates of 13.8% for scheduled cesarean deliveries and 22.5% for unscheduled cesarean deliveries.
